slides.title: Drill 1 Overview: Accident Management - Training IDs 1.1-1.4
content: This drill covers 4 sequential training scenarios:
• Training ID 1.1: Principles of Accident Management
• Training ID 1.3: Soft Tissue Injury Management
• Training ID 1.4: Shock Recognition and Management
Each scenario must be completed before proceeding to the next.

slides.title: Training ID 1.1: Principles of Accident Management
content: • Discuss basic principles of accident management
• Understand primary and secondary survey techniques
• Apply systematic approach to accident scenes

slides.title: Training ID 1.3: Soft Tissue Injury Management
content: • Assess and classify soft tissue injuries

slides.title: Training ID 1.4: Shock Recognition and Management
Drill 1 Assessment: Training IDs 1.1-1.4
content: Red: Does not meet minimum expectations.
Amber: Meets and demonstrates the basic requirements.
Green: Meets and demonstrates a thorough understanding.
• Show competency in bleeding control techniques
• Apply appropriate soft tissue wound care
All 4 training scenarios (1.1-1.4) must be completed successfully before proceeding to Drill 2.
